security-bot: ALERT: image digest drift detected for deployment/order-processor on node gke-prod-3. anomaly_score=0.92, pulled_digest=sha256:ab12..., expected_digest=sha256:cd34...
Emma (eng-security): seeing a spike in KMS decrypts tied to that pod's SA in the last 10m. can someone take node and pod details?
Raj (eng-sre): I'm pulling logs. Node gke-prod-3 shows a container with hostPID=true and hostPath:/proc mounted. PID 1 inside container is sh -> suspicious.
Luca (eng-runtime): copying relevant kubectl: 
```
kubectl get pod order-processor-7f8b -n payments -o yaml
# shows hostPID: true, hostNetwork: false, hostPath mount: /proc -> /host/proc
```
Alice (oncall): cordoning node now and killing the pod. cordon gke-prod-3; kubectl delete pod order-processor-7f8b -n payments --grace-period=0 --force
SRE-Mike: node cordoned, pod deleted. also removed dockersocket bind mounts from similar pods via patch.
Emma (eng-security): good. we should revoke tokens used by that serviceaccount and rotate any KMS keys used. Raj, can you revoke SA token and create a replacement?
Raj (eng-sre): revoked SA "payments-processor-sa" token, created new SA with stricter RBAC. Recorded in cluster audit (audit id a-2024-11-02-459).
Luca (eng-runtime): quick forensic notes: image manifest shows expected image was pushed 2024-10-28, but node pulled a different digest. kubelet reported pull success from registry mirror with header X-Image-Source: mirror.internal.redwood. Need to check mirror integrity.
Emma (eng-security): IO: escalate to registry team and KMS team. I've opened SEC-JIRA-3219 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3219) with summary "Image mirror integrity / hostPID privileged pod compromise". Add timeline and logs.
SRE-Mike: enabling extra audit logging for image pulls and kubelet actions on prod clusters. Will push audit-policy change and increase retention for 30d.
Alice (oncall): quick mitigation: admission controller rule enforced to forbid hostPID and hostNetwork unless exempted. pushed a deny policy to gatekeeper in all prod clusters.
Luca (eng-runtime): running a cluster-wide search for any other pods with hostPID true or hostPath mounts to /proc or /host. found 3 matches in staging only, none in prod besides the one.
Emma (eng-security): recommend rotating KMS key used by mirror credentials and rotating registry mirror credentials. Also add verification: image signature verification in admission flow (cosign).
Raj (eng-sre): done: rotated mirror creds and scheduled KMS key rotation. I also added a cron to verify image digests against cosign signatures nightly.
Emma (eng-security): action items: 1) Postmortem (assign to Luca), 2) Add automated alert for hostPID mounts (security-bot), 3) Harden default SA RBAC and remove create/exec rights, 4) Registry mirrors to implement checksum verification and signature enforcement.
Luca (eng-runtime): will own postmortem. Drafting timeline now. we should include steps to restore any potentially affected node; recommend rebuild node images and reprovision.
SRE-Mike: scheduling node rebuild for gke-prod-3 during maintenance window.
Alice (oncall): customer-impact check: payments queue had 12 failed jobs during the window; restarted processors, backfilled. Notifying ops leads.
Emma (eng-security): communication: sending note to security@ and infra@, and creating incident channel #inc-3219-image-integrity for cross-team discussion.
security-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-3219-image-integrity
Raj (eng-sre): closing immediate containment. will attach logs and kube audit to the jira. further triage in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
